scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Manchester United fan!
It starts when you're six. Your dad shows you the trophy cabinet. Thirteen league titles. One manager. You think this is normal.
Age nine. The legend retires. Fans put up a banner for the new manager: "The Chosen One." A few months later, a plane flies over the stadium. The banner says: "Wrong One."
Age twelve. New manager. Again. And again. You stop learning their names. You just call them "Gaffer."
Age fourteen. Ronaldo comes back! The king is home! One year later, he leaves... after a TV interview.
Age sixteen. You finish fifteenth. Your dad says: "I remember when we won the treble." You say: "I remember when it didn't rain inside the stadium."
Age seventeen. Europa League final. Against Tottenham. You lose. Your Spurs friend still hasn't stopped talking about it.
That's the thing about being a United fan. Your dad had the glory years.
You have the stories. And a bucket for the roof.
Tag a United fan who's still waiting. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
